integrity: Exact scalar reduction and critical asymptotics proved analytically; independently reproducible rational arithmetic checks are supporting finite examples, not infinite proof.
limitations: An asymptotic equilibrium-existence theorem for fixed positive rates, not a claim about dynamical stability, calibrated epidemiological forecasts, or uniformity at degenerate parameter limits; literature comparison may omit unindexed results.
title: A sharp strong-reinfection floor and two-scale endemic branches in an SEIRV model
